entities.summary: Matthew Charles Crockett is an American country music singer, songwriter, musician, and actor. He has released 16 studio albums since 2015, with The Man from Waco, $10 Cowboy, Lonesome Drifter, and Dollar a Day all breaking into the US Billboard 200 in 2022, 2024, and 2025, respectively.
